item.blurb: Guava Raises $12.5M Seed. Guava raises $12.5M seed round led by Acrew Capital to expand its full-stack developer platform for building AI voice agents for enterprise use.
E2e Raises $8M Seed. E2e raises $8M in seed funding to develop a verification layer for agentic coding and expand its open-source software testing framework.

Reflex Raises $15M Series A. Reflex raises $15M in Series A funding led by Standard Capital to scale its open-source Python web framework and enterprise features.
Hex Technologies Raises $100M Series D. Hex Technologies raises $100M Series D led by Peak XV Partners at a $1.2B valuation to advance its AI-powered data analytics and agent-first platform.

Hoxton Wealth Raises $135M Strategic Minority Investment. Hoxton Wealth raises $135 million in growth capital from Aspirity Partners to expand its wealth management platform and international operations.
